findHeaderCells.narration: Walk up from the clicked column header to its enclosing thead.
Collect all header cells in that thead row to refresh sort indicators.

readSearchQuery.narration: Walk up to the enclosing table parent container.
Locate the table search input if the search toolbar is rendered.
Read any active search filter so sorting preserves filtered results.

findHelperBadge.narration: Walk up to the enclosing table parent container.
Locate the helper badge element inside the search helper slot.

findTableBody.narration: Walk up to the enclosing table element.
Select the live tbody element for that table.
